license_policy: Only licensed-free sources with source and license metadata may be added. Verify the applicable source license before download or redistribution.

record_schema.image_id: Stable project-local identifier, for example fox_001
record_schema.source_url: Canonical page or image source URL
record_schema.source_provider: Source name, for example Unsplash or Pexels
record_schema.creator_name: Credited creator when supplied by the source
record_schema.license_name: Verified license or source usage terms
record_schema.license_url: URL to the verified license or terms
record_schema.downloaded_at: ISO-8601 timestamp recorded by the future download process
